pages.text: Found in $(item)Mesa$() biomes inside of the first simulation.$(br2)Your $(item)Nature's Compass$() will guide the way.$(br2)You should probably divine for both the $(item)Mesa$() and $(item)Mesa Plateau$() biomes to see which one is closer.
This knowledge is required before you can make a $(l:sim_1/3_creosote#engineers-hammer)Engineers Hammer$().
